summary: This screen is a split-screen SaaS authentication portal for Nimbus. It features a testimonial and brand hero panel on the left and an email/password plus Google OAuth login form on the right.

stack.name: Next.js (App Router)
stack.why: Combines React client components with server routes for auth and API handlers.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Enables rapid styling matching the measured blue gradient and form dimensions.

stack.name: Auth.js / NextAuth
stack.why: Provides built-in session handling for Credentials and Google OAuth providers.

stack.name: PostgreSQL (Neon)
stack.why: Serverless Postgres database with free tier suited for user credentials and profiles.

stack.name: Prisma ORM
stack.why: Type-safe database client and migrations for auth tables.

stack.name: Vercel
stack.why: Native zero-config hosting for Next.js applications and edge functions.

components.name: TestimonialSidebar
components.purpose: Renders the left brand showcase with logo, testimonial quote, and author credentials over a vibrant blue-cyan gradient.

components.name: LoginForm
components.purpose: Manages form state, validation, submission, and displays validation errors for email and password.

components.name: GoogleButton
components.purpose: Provides standard OAuth sign-in trigger with the branded Google multi-color icon.

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Reusable text input component with custom border styling and placeholder text.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Custom styled checkbox for the 'Remember me' option.

steps.title: Initialize Next.js project with Tailwind CSS
steps.detail: Create a new Next.js project using Tailwind CSS and configure basic fonts and colors in tailwind.config.ts.
steps.code:
npx create-next-app@latest nimbus-auth --typescript --tailwind --app
cd nimbus-auth
npm i @prisma/client next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter bcryptjs
npm i -D prisma @types/bcryptjs
steps.check: Local dev server runs on localhost:3000 without errors.

steps.title: Configure design tokens in Tailwind
steps.detail: Update tailwind.config.ts with the exact measured colors: primary blue (#4f46e5), surface (#3c53cd), background (#f1f5f9), and text colors.
steps.check: Custom classes like bg-nimbus-surface compile successfully.

steps.title: Implement the split-screen layout
steps.detail: Build the grid/flex structure in app/login/page.tsx: left half desktop hero with min-h-screen, right half centered container for login.
steps.check: On desktop, screen divides evenly 50/50; collapses on mobile screens.

steps.title: Build TestimonialSidebar with gradient background
steps.detail: Assemble components/auth/TestimonialSidebar.tsx with the Nimbus logo, quote, and speaker attribution over a linear blue-teal gradient.
steps.check: Sidebar renders brand icon top-left and quote bottom-left on desktop.

steps.title: Create reusable Input and Checkbox components
steps.detail: Build components/ui/Input.tsx to standardize the 46px height, rounded corners, subtle borders, and label placements.
steps.check: Inputs visually match screenshot border radius and measured 46px height.

steps.title: Assemble LoginForm with state handling
steps.detail: Implement email, password, and remember-me state along with Forgot Password and Register links inside components/auth/LoginForm.tsx.
steps.check: Form elements render cleanly with matching font weights and heights.

steps.title: Add Google OAuth Button and divider
steps.detail: Add the 'or' divider and components/auth/GoogleButton.tsx including the multi-color Google SVG icon.
steps.check: Divider and Google button match screenshot alignment and borders.

steps.title: Wire NextAuth and Prisma for backend authentication
steps.detail: Define User schema in prisma/schema.prisma and set up CredentialsProvider and GoogleProvider in app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts.

behaviour: Work email field validates email format before allowing form submission.
Clicking 'Log in' triggers credentials validation; invalid passwords display inline error alerts.
Clicking 'Continue with Google' triggers OAuth redirect via NextAuth signIn('google').
'Remember me' sets extended JWT/session cookie expiration if toggled.
'Forgot password?' links to password reset request route.
'Create an account' redirects to /signup registration flow.
data: currentUserSession: user ID, email, avatar URL, authenticated status

backend.summary: Handles session token creation, password hashing comparison via bcrypt, and OAuth redirection with Google.
backend.database: PostgreSQL on Neon for storing account credentials, user profiles, and session tokens.
backend.auth: NextAuth JWT session management. Issues an HTTP-only secure cookie upon successful login.

tables.name: users
tables.columns: id uuid pk, email text unique, password_hash text, created_at timestamptz

tables.name: accounts
tables.columns: id uuid pk, user_id uuid references users(id), provider text, provider_account_id text

endpoints.purpose: Validates email/password credentials and issues JWT session cookie
Retrieves the active user session status

rules: Email must be non-empty and match valid email format regex
Password must be at least 8 characters
Accounts with existing Google OAuth logins cannot authenticate via blank password

pitfalls: Using an insecure client-side redirect before session cookies are set, leading to race condition flashes.
Neglecting responsiveness: forgetting to hide the sidebar testimonial on mobile screens, squeezing form content.
Missing accessible labels for the input fields or relying solely on placeholders for label information.
Hardcoding external API credentials instead of loading through NEXT_PUBLIC_ or server environment variables.
testing: Form submits with valid email and password format
Invalid email format displays a HTML5 or custom validation warning
Clicking Google button calls NextAuth signIn('google') function
Viewport changes under 768px hide TestimonialSidebar and center the login card
deploy: Create a PostgreSQL instance on Neon.tech and copy DATABASE_URL
Run 'npx prisma db push' to apply schema to the Neon database
Deploy repository to Vercel and populate NEXTAUTH_SECRET, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables

tokens.method: Colours: pixel quantisation of the whole screenshot and of each detected element. Font sizes: text box height ÷ 1.25. Spacing: gaps between sibling boxes, snapped to a 4px grid. Measured approximations, not values read from source code.
